title: Derived observed-analogue parameters from OPSD time series (Germany)

source.name: Open Power System Data - Time series
source.sha256_source: published in datapackage.json resources[opsd_time_series_60min].hash and verified on the downloaded file

license.opsd_package: No data licence in datapackage.json (licenses: null); the OPSD page states 'Text is licensed under CC-BY license' (text only). OPSD notes primary data come from ENTSO-E Transparency.
license.assessment: Actual total load (Transparency Regulation Art. 6.1.a), actual generation per production type (16.1.b/c) and installed generation capacity (14.1.a) are not among the 35 items of ENTSO-E's list of data for free re-use under CC BY 4.0, so redistribution permission for these columns is not established.
license.committed_content: derived hourly multipliers and summary statistics only; no observed hourly series

attribution: Open Power System Data. 2020. Data Package Time series. Version 2020-10-06. https://doi.org/10.25832/time_series/2020-10-06. (Primary data from various sources, for a complete list see URL). Primary source of the DE columns used: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
missing_value_policy: No interpolation or filling. Hours absent from the source or empty are NaN; any UTC day/window with a NaN hour is excluded from detection; a mapped day must be complete.
